game_updates.contents: Friends, grab your floaties......it's release day for The Aquatic Planet Pack! This DLC features a plethora of pool-dwelling critters, flooded flora and submersible buildings...and Duplicants who learn to swim for the very first time in ONI history! The Aquatic Planet Pack plunges colonies into the deep end of a marine world of kelp forests and coral reefs, where expanded aquatic ranches cater to cuisine and construction projects alike, and clams grow bigger than Duplicants. There are brand-new biomes, plants, resources, foods and buildings, plus two new recruits—including one who's unnaturally well-adapted to the environment. (And needs to be convinced to join you.) game_updates.title: Abelard, introduce the sixth major update - 1.6!
game_updates.contents: Abelard, introduce the sixth major update! Update 1.6 prepares the game for the release of the Infinite Museion DLC. It features a significant rework for Uralon the Cruel, changes to Pasqal and Forge World origins, Operative buffs, Operative and Assassin key features working on additional turns, QoL talent UI updates, a lot of bug fixes and more! Highlights: Uralon the Cruel and his daemons - massive mechanics overhaul; Pasqal and Forge World origins updated to interact with the augmentation system from The Infinite Museion DLC; Operative and Assassin’s keystone features now work on additional turns; Many Operative talents have received better scaling; Grenades have been reworked to count as AoE attacks, can crit and receive bonus from INT and Demolition; Reworked UI for talent selection, ...

game_updates.title: June Hotfix 1.2.1
game_updates.contents: Greetings Exiles, We are releasing a new hotfix that will reintroduce all the changes and fixes we reverted from Patch 1.2.0. In addition to those changes, we are introducing the following fixes in Hotfix 1.2.1:Fixed an issue introduced in 1.2.0 where placeables on certain building pieces (including stonebrick ceilings and wedges, and Highland and Khitai roofs and foundations) could lose stability and disappear.Fixed an issue where logging in while standing on a foundation could drop players through it, leaving them stuck inside the structure.Fixed iron bars displaying the cultist hood icon in inventories and crafting stations. Gone but not forgotten, Cultist Hood icon - June 2026 - June 2026Full 1.2.0 Patch notes

game_updates.title: Free DLC (New Map) for Medieval Dynasty!
game_updates.contents: Free DLC (New Map) for Medieval Dynasty! We have some additional news to share with you today. You’ve been asking for a long time for a new map, so here it is! In 2027 we'll be releasing a free DLC called The Backwood. This uninhabited terrain is completely yours to build, test, and design! To allow you to unleash your creativity, The Backwood map will be available in a special Creative Mode, so if you desire, you won’t need to worry about money, resources, and reputation anymore! We’ve prepared a special teaser for you to give you a better idea of what's coming to the game. See The Backwood DLC Steam page to learn more and add it to your wishlist! Kind regards Render Cube and Toplitz teams

game_updates.title: Early Access Hotfix #117
game_updates.contents: Hi Adventurers,This hotfix brings polish and balance to the recently added features. This includes adding new treasure rooms and mining ores to the recently added the Firedeep levels. We’ve also made numerous adjustments to the economy, making rare items more valuable. We’ve tuned the balance for the game rules including the amount of AP earned for kills and going down a floor. We’ve also made further adjustments to the Dark Swarm phases in the Squire Royale mode. This update also brings the seductive Succubus race to the game including matching exquisite weapon skins. Thank you and see you in the dungeons!IRONMACEBugfixes:Fixed an issue where frame drops could occur when a Ranger’s Explosive Shot hit a target.Fixed an issue where the Ghost King could be blocked by a Druid's Thorn Barrier ...

game_updates.title: 30 DAYS LEFT!
game_updates.contents: As part of the 8AM series, this new entry takes players into a subway environment where observation, attention to detail, and quick decision-making are essential. Players will monitor camera feeds, identify anomalies, and report anything that should not be there before the situation escalates.With only one month remaining until release, we invite you to add 8AM: The Subway to your Steam wishlist and follow the game to stay updated ahead of launch.Thank you for your continued support.

game_updates.title: Apex Legends: Matchmaking Tests Update
game_updates.contents: For a fully translated version of the update, see here.As part of our ongoing commitment to transparency, we’ve been more direct in sharing our approach to developing Apex Legends, a critical part of this approach is listening to you all in the community, understanding their needs, and working to address them. As such, we wanted to highlight the work being done on matchmaking to provide an even better experience for our players.Below, we’ll be discussing the frustrations we’re consistently working to alleviate, the various changes we’ve made and tests we’ve run, what outcomes we’re targeting, as well as what we’ve learned and how we’re using it to improve matchmaking moving forward. Read on to learn all about:Five major matchmaking pain pointsParameters and results of recent matchmaking te...

game_updates.title: Balance Dev Blog - June 2026
game_updates.contents: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/cbc9fdf9a7d7515ef20828df32a397fa4e9f47bd.png Hello friends! In just a few days we will find ourselves in the eye of the Oceania Storm expansion. As always when new releases hit, they are accompanied by some balance adjustments. We made some serious changes in the April patch that had a big impact on the meta. As a result, there are no huge offenders to go after this time around. There are a few archetypes that we are closely monitoring, such as the various burn variants and Resistance, but none of these are popular or strong enough to warrant a drastic action at this time.
